articles.title: Thomas Markle’s Shock S*x Admission; Meghan’s Father Breaks Silence
articles.description: Meghan Markle’s estranged father has made a startling admission as a deeply troubling controversy engulfs the family. Thomas Markle, 82, told The Mail on Sunday that he paid for sex with prostitutes during trips to the Philippines when he was single, declaring: “I like Asian women but that is not a crime.” The former Hollywood lighting technician has denied ever having sex with anyone under 18 and insists he has nothing to hide. His comments come as Philippine authorities investigate separate allegations that child sexual abuse images were found among belongings at his former home. Thomas says he is willing to speak to investigators and undergo a lie detector test as the case draws fresh attention to Meghan’s estrangement from her father.

articles.title: Scientists tracked 142 Burmese pythons for 20 years; only four expelled transmitters
articles.description: Scientists tracked 142 adult Burmese pythons in southern Florida over 20 years using implanted radio transmitters. Out of 305 transmitters, only four were expelled, all from pregnant females, indicating a low expulsion rate. The study found no transmitter-related deaths and monitored pythons regularly for health issues. Researchers suggest that modifying implantation methods may reduce expulsion risk in pregnant females.
